reviews.title: It’s “Fine”
reviews.text: It’s not a bad game, just, super average. I played for a couple months, it’s certainly worthwhile if you like the genre and other games in it. But it’s very generic. Selection of cookie-cutter characters over however many factions and they fight each other on pre-determined boards. You AFK for various currencies to buy stuff and upgrade, and play the gachas to get copies and “star up” and you can get pets to fight alongside them and so on and so forth. And yes, it’s pay-to-win. Admittedly, it’s still on the better side in gameplay, but the game lacks character, or identity. If you’re new to the genre, there’s better, but if you’re familiar, you’ll enjoy it. I definitely did.

reviews.title: Paywalls Galore
reviews.text:
First and foremost, this game does have potential. Game concept is fun, but:
Progress is Stuck behind paywalls after the first Day
Have to select server and account every login which is tedious
New servers daily which means your account is suck with Whales and servers get ‘full’ so you are limited to friends/alliances that don’t play
Game is a quick cash grab and not designed for a long term gotcha RPG

reviews.title: Overall score
reviews.text: Played since it launched and it’s time for a review. Decent gatcha. I’ll spend cash if it’s worth it but progressing through, it isnt. It’s a heavily cash grabber to progress. Pull rates are unbelievable horrible too. The biggest issue right now is team building. My team that’s built with no cash, there’s no team comp that’s good enough to progress unless money is involved or lucky pulls. Many times I’ll get annihilated to an underpowered cash player. I’ll manage to do other things to improve overall power but I’m starting to think that there’s no other strategy that is better than $. On the positive side, music is great, I do enjoying watching and playing the game after all, it is an afk.
